question:
**Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:**

The perception that the guidelines are optional (1)/ rather than compulsory have led (2)/ to widespread inconsistencies in compliance (3)/ across state-level implementations. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in part 2 of the sentence: "rather than compulsory **have led**."
 
• The subject "The perception" is singular, so the verb should be singular as well.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**has led**" instead of "have led."
 
• Thus, the error is in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The perception that the guidelines are optional rather than compulsory **has led** to widespread inconsistencies in compliance across state-level implementations."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "The perception that the guidelines are optional"** – This part of the sentence is correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3: "to widespread inconsistencies in compliance"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "across state-level implementations"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
